name: confirmation off sends once and does not prompt
Apply has visible feedback and leaves body readable
unrelated request cannot dismiss Apply feedback
autosave controls freeze, including dynamic fragments, and restore prior state
server error retains pending changes and restores controls
success explicitly confirms and clears pending changes
warnings are distinct from clean success
error details never execute returned HTML
malformed JSON leaves pending state and shows unknown result
permission failure directs user to login
timeout is uncertain and does not automatically repeat Apply
